crossRefs.note: Jesus said to him, “ ‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’
He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know…
“If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and…
that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who…
So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than…
For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.
He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose…
However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.
“Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.
But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are…
Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen…
This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom…
Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for…

translations.web: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.
translations.bsb: Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me;
translations.kjv: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
